en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large, multi‑storey building complex with red mansard roofs and light stone façades, enclosed by a wall and gatehouse. In front of the entrance stand numerous uniformed soldiers, some on horseback, suggesting a military facility or barracks. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds, and tall trees flank the gate. Printed German text appears at the top identifying the location and the military function of the building.
